welcome.name: Welcome series
welcome.intent: Welcome new sign-ups and follow up only when they have not engaged.

config.subject: Welcome, {{first_name}}
config.body: Here is how to get started.
{{first_name}}, your welcome gift is waiting.

engagement_score_follow_up.name: Engagement score follow-up
engagement_score_follow_up.intent: Use engagement score to personalize follow-up and stop after a purchase.

config.subject: {{first_name}}, your personalized update
config.body: Your personalized recommendations are ready. Come back when you are ready.

config.title: Still thinking it over?
config.body: {{first_name}}, your personalized recommendations are one tap away.

config.title: Your recommendations are ready
config.body: {{first_name}}, come back for your personalized recommendations.

winback.name: Win-back
winback.intent: Re-engage inactive customers and stop follow-ups after a purchase.

config.subject: We miss you, {{first_name}}
config.body: Take a look at what is new since your last visit.
{{first_name}}, we would love to welcome you back.

post_purchase.name: Post-purchase care
post_purchase.intent: Thank customers after an order and tailor follow-up to their engagement.

config.subject: How was your order, {{first_name}}?
config.body: We hope everything arrived safely. Tell us what you think.

config.title: Need help with your order?
config.body: We are here if anything is off, {{first_name}}.

travel_preparation.name: Trip preparation
travel_preparation.intent: Send useful trip information and check whether travelers have seen it.

config.subject: Your trip is coming up, {{first_name}}
config.body: Review your itinerary and travel details before departure.
{{first_name}}, your trip details are ready to review.

course_enrollment.name: Course enrollment
course_enrollment.intent: Welcome learners, then guide them toward their first course resource.

config.subject: Your learning journey starts here, {{first_name}}
config.body: Open your course guide and choose a good time for your first lesson.
{{first_name}}, your course guide is ready when you are.

replenishment_reminder.name: Replenishment reminder
replenishment_reminder.intent: Remind repeat-purchase customers when it may be time to restock.

config.subject: Ready for a restock, {{first_name}}?
config.body: If you are running low, your usual items are ready to reorder.

config.title: Need a restock?
config.body: {{first_name}}, your favorites are easy to reorder.

retail_loyalty.name: Loyalty member activation
retail_loyalty.intent: Recognize loyalty members and invite other shoppers to join the program.

config.title: A thank-you for being a member
config.body: {{first_name}}, take a look at your latest member rewards.

config.subject: Get more from your next visit, {{first_name}}
config.body: Join our loyalty program to hear about member benefits.

restaurant_feedback.name: Dining follow-up
restaurant_feedback.intent: Thank guests after a visit and offer a second feedback route if needed.

config.subject: Thanks for visiting, {{first_name}}
config.body: We hope you enjoyed your meal. We would value your feedback.
{{first_name}}, how was your recent dining experience?

hospitality_prearrival.name: Pre-arrival guest journey
hospitality_prearrival.intent: Share arrival information before a stay and check whether guests have seen it.

config.subject: We look forward to welcoming you, {{first_name}}
config.body: Your stay is coming up. Review arrival details and let us know if you need help.
{{first_name}}, reply if you need help getting ready for your stay.

account_opening.name: Account opening follow-up
account_opening.intent: Help new applicants finish opening an account, then tag those who start setup.

config.subject: Finish opening your account, {{first_name}}
config.body: Your application is almost complete. Pick up where you left off.
{{first_name}}, your account is waiting. Finish in a few minutes.

card_activation.name: Card activation reminder
card_activation.intent: Remind new cardholders to activate their card, with a stronger nudge for engaged customers.

config.title: Activate your card
config.body: {{first_name}}, one tap to start using your new card.

config.subject: Activate your card to start earning rewards
config.body: Activate your card in the app to start using it today.

course_reengagement.name: Course re-engagement
course_reengagement.intent: Bring back learners who stopped partway through a course.

config.subject: Your course is waiting, {{first_name}}
config.body: Pick up your next lesson where you stopped.

config.title: Your next lesson is ready
config.body: {{first_name}}, a short lesson is ready when you are.

appointment_reminder.name: Check-up reminder
appointment_reminder.intent: Remind patients when a routine check-up is due and make booking easy.

config.subject: Your routine check-up is due, {{first_name}}
config.body: Choose a time that suits you. Use the app or reply to schedule.
{{first_name}}, book your check-up in two taps.

post_visit_care.name: Post-visit follow-up
post_visit_care.intent: Check in after a visit and route patients who need more support to a care contact.

config.subject: How are you feeling, {{first_name}}?
config.body: If anything is unclear after your visit, we are here to help.
{{first_name}}, reply if you would like a call from our care team.

table_reservation.name: Table reservation reminder
table_reservation.intent: Confirm an upcoming booking, then check whether the guest returns.

config.body: {{first_name}}, your table is booked for tomorrow. Reply to change it.

policy_renewal.name: Policy renewal reminder
policy_renewal.intent: Remind policyholders before renewal, then follow up by SMS if they have not renewed.

config.subject: Your policy renews soon, {{first_name}}
config.body: Review your cover and renew in a few minutes.
{{first_name}}, renew your policy to keep your cover active.

quote_followup.name: Quote follow-up
quote_followup.intent: Finish unfinished quotes. Higher-scoring prospects get an email, others get a push reminder.

config.subject: {{first_name}}, finish your quote
config.body: Your quote is saved. Complete it in a few minutes.

config.title: Your quote is saved
config.body: {{first_name}}, pick up where you left off.

b2b_reorder.name: Supply reorder reminder
b2b_reorder.intent: Remind trade customers when a reorder is due, then escalate by push if they have not ordered.

config.subject: Time to reorder supplies, {{first_name}}
config.body: Your usual order is ready to confirm. Reorder in one step.

config.title: Reorder reminder
config.body: {{first_name}}, your supply order is ready to confirm.

product_registration.name: Product registration
product_registration.intent: Ask new buyers to register their product for warranty support, then nudge by SMS.

config.subject: Register your product, {{first_name}}
config.body: Registering takes two minutes and activates your warranty.
{{first_name}}, register your product to activate your warranty.

trial_activation.name: Trial activation
trial_activation.intent: Welcome new subscribers and recommend a first title. Engaged trials get a push.

config.subject: Your trial has started, {{first_name}}
config.body: Here is how to find something to watch tonight.

config.title: Pick your first show
config.body: {{first_name}}, new titles are waiting for you.

config.subject: Here is what to watch next
config.body: Browse our top picks for new subscribers.

lapsed_viewer.name: Lapsed viewer win-back
lapsed_viewer.intent: Bring back viewers who have been inactive for 30 days with new releases, then offer a text reminder.

config.title: New releases you may like
config.body: {{first_name}}, fresh titles just landed.
{{first_name}}, a new season is ready to watch.

new_listing_alert.name: New listing alert
new_listing_alert.intent: Send buyers new homes that match their search, then follow up by SMS if they do not engage.

config.subject: New homes that match your search, {{first_name}}
config.body: Here are the newest listings in your preferred area.
{{first_name}}, new listings are live. Take a look.

viewing_followup.name: Viewing follow-up
viewing_followup.intent: Follow up with buyers who looked at a home but did not book a second viewing.

config.subject: Still interested in this home, {{first_name}}?
config.body: Book a second viewing at a time that works for you.

config.title: Book a second viewing
config.body: {{first_name}}, a slot is open this week.

plan_upgrade.name: Plan upgrade offer
plan_upgrade.intent: Offer a higher data plan to high-engagement customers and share plan details with others.

config.title: Upgrade for more data
config.body: {{first_name}}, a bigger plan is available for you.

config.subject: Your plan at a glance
config.body: Review your data, calls and included extras.

line_activation.name: Line activation
line_activation.intent: Help new subscribers activate their line by SMS, then tag those who have not activated.

config.body: {{first_name}}, activate your line in two minutes.
